name: The Pariah's Instructions

faq.answer: He is an exiled centaur wandering southern Desolace, shunned by the warring clans of his people.
The Amulet of Union is a relic resting within the depths of Maraudon that the Centaur Pariah seeks to recover.
faq.q: What is the Amulet of Union?

faq.answer: The pariah keeps to the southern reaches of Desolace, away from the strongholds of the main clans.
faq.q: Where does the Centaur Pariah wait?

sections.body: South across the grey wastes of Desolace wanders the Centaur Pariah, cast out from the warring clans of his kin. He has entrusted you with his written words, urging a journey into the sacred caverns of Maraudon. Deep within those halls lies the Amulet of Union, an artifact he bids you recover and carry back to his lonely camp.
sections.title: A Plea from the Outcast

summary: In the wastes of Desolace, an outcast centaur has handed you a set of written directions. He wants an ancient relic known as the Amulet of Union brought out from the depths of Maraudon. What he intends to do with such a charm remains between you and the pariah.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Pariah's Instructions
